justification: The passage states outright what happens before the wind drops: “While the wind is still on the wall, it pushes in at those same joints, and the tray holds what it has collected.” That is exactly D — the collected water stays on the tray because the wind presses in at the joints; only “In the lull, the tray lets go.” A is contradicted twice (nothing runs during the wind, and “Not all of the joints run, and none for long”); B is contradicted because water has already reached the tray, which “holds what it has collected”; C gets the observation half-right but its diagnosis is barred — the missing stop end is only one of two guesses about a head that “gives back nothing an hour after the wind drops,” and “an open joint cannot say” which.

The mechanism is spelled out: “Kornet låg sedan kvar i det färdiga teglet och tog upp fukt ur luften, svällde och tryckte loss en flisa ur ytan.” That is C. B is contradicted by the very next line, “I ugnen hände detta sällan” — the fault “visade sig först långt efter bränningen.” A misapplies the frost, which acted on the lersträngar before forming (“så att massan i april var lös”), not on masonry; D’s rapid cooling is never mentioned as a cause of anything.

Colour is tied to position in the ring-kiln chamber: “Var i kammaren en sten hade stått syntes på den efteråt. De stenar som stod närmast eldkanalerna blev täta och mörka … medan de som stod ytterst mot kammarväggen kom ut bleka och porösa.” That is B. D is ruled out because the two clays were blended — “efter 1875 brändes inget tegel av enbart den ena sorten”; A’s lime content is linked to spalling, not colour; C’s drying time governs summer output (“hur mycket gods som fick plats under taken”), not colour.

The watering made the lime slake “medan teglet stod kvar på bruksgården,” and “De stenar som sprack på gården kördes ut i brukets egen vägfyllning” — the loss lands on the works instead of in a customer’s wall, which is D. B is contradicted by “Av de klagomål som bruket tog emot under 1890-talet gällde nästan alla sådant tegel som hade spruckit sedan det murats in,” and the treatment “nådde bara de korn som satt nära ytan.” C is contradicted by the same road-fill sentence (cracked stones were not sold), and A’s frost-hardening is never claimed — “Vattningen gjorde ingen sten hel igen.”

The ring kiln reuses the same heat twice: “Luften som drogs in mot elden passerade först de färdigbrända stenar som stod och svalnade, och kom därför varm fram. Rökgaserna leddes ut genom kamrarna längre fram i ringen, där de torkade det gods som stod på tur att brännas,” summed up as “Samma värme fick i stället göra nytta i två led.” That is A. B is contradicted verbatim by “Elden brann inte hetare än förr”; the kollergång in C is introduced against kalkspräckning, with no claim about firing time; D is unsupported — the skärmtaken still cap the summer’s output and appear in the 1896 brandförsäkring.

The author sets the budget claim against what can be documented: the proposal stands “bredvid en beräknad besparing på 1,4 miljoner kronor om året,” while “Näversved beräknar besparingen där till knappt 90 000 kronor om året. Det är den enda besparing som går att belägga i förväg.” Roughly one-sixteenth of the claimed saving is provable — C. D overshoots: the author concedes an established ~90 000 kr and also refuses to dismiss the fleet-size argument (“Det argumentet kan jag inte räkna bort”). A is contradicted by “Någon ny avståndsgräns krävs inte för det,” and B (cautious, stepwise implementation) is never addressed.

The overlay result is stated directly: “Sextioen elever i årskurs 4–6 bor mellan två och tre kilometer från sin skola, och femtioåtta av dem stiger på vid hållplatser som redan trafikeras av turer som körs för yngre eller äldre elevers skull. Fordonen står alltså kvar oavsett var gränsen dras.” That is A, near-verbatim (58 of 61). B inverts the text’s own rule, “antalet fordon bestäms av turplaneringen”; C is contradicted by the two stickvägar whose “avstickare skulle gå att stryka ur turplaneringen”; D reverses the proportion — the stops are ones “som redan trafikeras” for other pupils’ sake.

The passage states directly that before the wind drops the tray retains its water: "While the wind is still on the wall, it pushes in at those same joints, and the tray holds what it has collected. In the lull, the tray lets go." A is contradicted twice over — the wind "pushes in at those same joints", it does not force water out of them, and "Not all of the joints run, and none for long." B is contradicted by the fact that the water has already arrived: "The water that gets past it runs down into the cavity, onto a tray bedded in over the opening", and the tray "holds what it has collected" — collection is complete, discharge is what is delayed. C gets the observable right but attaches a diagnosis the text explicitly refuses: silence during the wind is normal, only "A head that gives back nothing an hour after the wind drops is worth recording", and even then "an open joint cannot say" whether the cause is dropped mortar or "a missing stop end".

The mechanism is spelled out: "Kornet låg sedan kvar i det färdiga teglet och tog upp fukt ur luften, svällde och tryckte loss en flisa ur ytan" — swelling from moisture uptake after firing, which is C. B is the deliberate near-miss and is killed by the very next sentence, "I ugnen hände detta sällan", plus "Det hände när stenen hade stått en tid i stapeln eller redan var inmurad". A misapplies the frost, which acts on the clay strings before forming ("vattnet i klumparna frös, utvidgade sig och sprängde sönder dem"), never on fired brick in a wall. D invents rapid cooling; the emptying of burnt-out chambers is described only as part of the ring kiln's cycle, never as a cause of surface damage.

Colour is tied to position in the firing chamber: "Var i kammaren en sten hade stått syntes på den efteråt. De stenar som stod närmast eldkanalerna blev täta och mörka ... medan de som stod ytterst mot kammarväggen kom ut bleka och porösa." D is excluded because the two clays were never fired separately after 1875 — "Leran från de båda gravarna blandades på slagbordet, och efter 1875 brändes inget tegel av enbart den ena sorten" — so pit of origin cannot explain three distinct colours in one wall. A confuses the lime grit with colour; the kalkstensgrus is credited only with "ett fel som visade sig först långt efter bränningen", never with hue. C misreads the drying yard, which governs how much the works could deliver ("Vad bruket kunde leverera under en sommar avgjordes därför av hur mycket gods som fick plats under taken"), not appearance.

The watering moves the failure earlier and onto the works' own ground: it let "kalken hann släckas medan teglet stod kvar på bruksgården", and "De stenar som sprack på gården kördes ut i brukets egen vägfyllning" — a loss the works absorbed rather than the customer's wall, which is D. B is refuted by the complaint record itself: "Av de klagomål som bruket tog emot under 1890-talet gällde nästan alla sådant tegel som hade spruckit sedan det murats in", i.e. complaints continued through the watering years, because "den nådde bara de korn som satt nära ytan". C is contradicted by the same road-fill sentence — cracked stones were not sold on at all. A imports a frost-resistance claim the text never makes and undercuts with "Vattningen gjorde ingen sten hel igen".

The saving is attributed to double use of the same heat: "Luften som drogs in mot elden passerade först de färdigbrända stenar som stod och svalnade, och kom därför varm fram. Rökgaserna leddes ut genom kamrarna längre fram i ringen, där de torkade det gods som stod på tur att brännas", summed up as "Samma värme fick i stället göra nytta i två led" — exactly A. B is explicitly denied one sentence earlier: "Elden brann inte hetare än förr." C exploits the fact that the kollergång was also installed in 1884, but its stated effect is on lime grains — "malde leran så hårt att de flesta kalkkornen krossades till stoft" — with no claim about denser clay or shorter firing. D is contradicted by the skärmtak still being insured in 1896 and by drying capacity still capping output; the flue gases dry goods inside the kiln, not on the torkbacke.

The author concedes exactly one demonstrable saving against the budgeted 1.4 million: "Näversved beräknar besparingen där till knappt 90 000 kronor om året. Det är den enda besparing som går att belägga i förväg." That is a fraction of the claimed sum, which is C. D overshoots: she does not claim zero — she books the 90 000 and explicitly refuses to dismiss the contract-renewal effect ("Det argumentet kan jag inte räkna bort, och jag tänker inte låtsas att jag kan"). A is contradicted by "Någon ny avståndsgräns krävs inte för det" — she says the procurement can size vehicles without any change of limit, not that the change is needed later. B is nowhere in the text; she recommends starting elsewhere entirely ("vill nämnden hitta dem bör den börja i turplaneringen"), not a gentler version of the same measure.

The overlay's finding is stated in one sentence: "femtioåtta av dem stiger på vid hållplatser som redan trafikeras av turer som körs för yngre eller äldre elevers skull. Fordonen står alltså kvar oavsett var gränsen dras." 58 of 61 is "nästan alla", and the vehicles remain — A. B inverts the text's own division of labour: "Reglerna för vem som är skjutsberättigad avgör därmed vilka som sitter i fordonen, medan antalet fordon bestäms av turplaneringen." C is the tempting over-claim and is false: the three remaining pupils live along two spur roads and "de avstickarna skulle gå att stryka ur turplaneringen", so something can indeed be cut. D reverses the proportion — only the two stickvägar are driven for these pupils' sake alone, while the bulk of stops are "redan trafikerade" for other year groups.

findings.quote: Hosing removes some of the smoke if it is done within a day of a fire.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind_pick null; leans B/D). Domain knowledge of smoke taint eliminates A and C passage-blind: volatile phenols are bound as glycosides inside the berry, so hosing the fruit is documented as ineffective. B and D remain substantive and the passage still decides between them, so this is world-knowledge answerability, not a structural leak.

findings.quote: They carry the phenols through to the bunches.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind_pick A). Standard smoke-taint viticulture: leaves absorb volatile phenols and translocate them to the bunches, so A is pickable without the passage. B, C and D are substantive alternative claims with no form-level asymmetry a non-expert could see, so flag rather than kill.

findings.quote: An ashy finish belongs to the wine alone, and a trained taster will always find it.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE plus a partial form tell (blind_pick C). B is the only absolute ('always') and D is a sweeping dismissal of the panel, both eliminable test-wise; domain knowledge that the ashy finish is partly generated in-mouth by salivary hydrolysis of glycosides then selects C. Form alone still leaves A vs C undecided, so flag, not structural leak.

findings.quote: Whatever the tray has caught stays on it, because the wind presses in at those joints.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE: cavity-tray/weep-hole building pathology decides it for a domain reader. Positive wind pressure on the face holds the tray's collected water back; the open perpends run only once the pressure differential goes, i.e. after the wind drops. A/B/C are all substantive positions in that same domain (A = naive 'wind forces it out', B = absorption-lag, C = missing-stop-end, a real and common defect), so the passage is still doing real work. No passage-free, domain-free mechanism delivers D.

findings.quote: The wind is still driving the rain into the brick, so little has reached the tray yet.
findings.note: Strip-the-absolutes re-run after the B rewrite: the tell no longer isolates anything. A ('Every joint ... is running') and C ('Nothing comes out') are hard universals; B is lexically hedged ('little ... yet') but D ('Whatever the tray has caught') is equally non-committal in force, so absoluteness splits 2-2. A crude 'pick the lexically hedged option' solver now lands on B, a distractor - the heuristic misfires rather than leaks. Repair verified effective.

findings.quote: Every joint above the opening is running, since the wind forces the water out through them.
findings.note: Residual soft narrowing, form-adjacent only: on direction the set is 3-1 (A = joints discharging vs B/C/D = little or nothing discharging), and B is the only option that never names the joints the stem asks about, so a test-wise solver can shed A and B and sit at C-vs-D 50/50. Deciding C vs D needs the stem presupposition ('before the wind drops' entails a wind-contingent state, which a missing stop end is not) - and that step requires knowing what a stop end is, i.e. domain, not form. Length is flat (91/86/87/86 chars, 16/17/16/16 words); longest-option points at A and misfires. Single-question sheet, so no cross-question corroboration channel exists.

findings.quote: Kalkkorn i stenen svällde när de tog upp fukt efter bränningen.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind_pick C). Lime blowing is textbook brick pathology: quicklime inclusions hydrate after firing, expand and pop flakes off the face, so C is pickable without the passage. A, B and D are substantive competing mechanisms rather than filler, so flag, not RECALL_ONLY.

findings.quote: En del av förlusten flyttades från kundens mur till bruksgården.
findings.note: PARTIALLY / WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind_pick D). B is the only absolute ('inga klagomål') and A asserts a mechanism that is false in the world (watering does not harden brick); knowing that watering finished brick is the standard remedy for lime blowing then selects D over its direct opposite C. The passage still grounds the inference, so flag.

findings.quote: Luften förvärmdes av svalnande stenar och rökgaserna torkade nästa gods.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind_pick A). The Hoffmann ring kiln's fuel saving is exactly this heat recuperation, and the '1884' cue points to a ring-kiln installation; D additionally fails stem-fit because awnings becoming superfluous does not explain wood consumption. Distractors are substantive, so flag.

findings.quote: Att bara en bråkdel av besparingen är påvisbar.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, best pick C. Chain: (1) D ('inte ... en enda krona') is the sole hard absolute and also the length outlier (34 chars vs 46-48), a visible throwaway; (2) A ('men först vid nästa upphandling', timing caveat) and B ('försiktigt och stegvis', pace caveat) are near-redundant 'yes, but not abruptly' stances that a test-wise reader distrusts as a mutually-cancelling pair - soft, since timing and manner are distinguishable in principle; (3) C is the hedged twin of D (same direction, weaker force) with a double hedge, quantitative ('bara en bråkdel') and epistemic ('påvisbar'), the classic key position. Better than chance, not decided by form alone.

findings.quote: Att den inte sparar en enda krona.
findings.note: Cross-question channel inside the sheet: q:2's four options are all about whether raising the limit would actually remove any tur, vehicle or stop, and no option anywhere in this sheet asserts that the saving is real - two q:1 options deny it, two dodge onto process. The sheet's own option composition therefore constrains the author's stance to savings-sceptical before any passage is read, which pushes the key into {C, D} and, with the absolutism tell on D, onto C. Passage-free and domain-free, but contingent enough on my own reading of q:1 to stay at major rather than lethal.

findings.quote: Antalet fordon som sätts in på morgonturerna styrs av hur många skjutsberättigade elever som stiger på.
findings.note: REPAIR VERIFIED: the old 4->1 method-derivability path is dead. Both rebuilt options now name predicates that laying pupil addresses over route timetables actually produces - B is a vehicle-allocation dependency readable off tur-by-tur boarding counts, D ('De flesta av hållplatserna ... trafikeras enbart för de berörda elevernas skull') is exactly what an address-on-stops overlay yields. Neither is a category error against the stated method any more, and both are substantive counter-positions to A (each implies the raise WOULD cut service, so the saving would be real). The previously named non-derivable predicates (cost-per-tur trend; municipal walkability judgement) do not appear anywhere in the current option set.

findings.quote: Nästan alla berörda elever åker med turer som ändå körs, och fordonen blir därför kvar.
findings.note: RESIDUAL BLIND FLOOR, best pick A. Pure form removes only C ('Ingen av de tjugotre ... skulle gå att korta', sole hard universal negative, also shortest at 73 chars) -> floor 1-in-3 over {A, B, D}. Direction is a clean 2-2 (A/C = no service removed, B/D = service driven by these pupils) so no cluster tell settles it; longest-option points at B (103 chars) and misfires; the conclusion-carrying tell also splits 2-2 (A and C both name the policy consequence, B and D are bare findings). Admitting the same cross-question channel flagged on q:1 - the sheet contains no 'the saving is real' stance anywhere - narrows to {A, C}, and the hedged twin ('Nästan alla') beats the absolute twin ('Ingen av de tjugotre'), landing on A. So the floor is 1-in-3 on form alone and a soft single pick once cross-question stance inference is allowed; every link is a prior rather than a mechanism, hence major not lethal.

findings.quote: Att byarna över huvud taget fick olika stångformer beror på att somliga sparade sin stomme.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind_pick null, leans D). C overreaches causally and A asserts unsupported deliberate intent; both are eliminable passage-blind, leaving B and D, which are near-paraphrases of one another. The passage is still needed to choose between them, so flag.

findings.quote: A head that gives back nothing an hour after the wind drops is worth recording, though whether the tray has been obstructed by mortar dropped during the build, or is spilling into the cavity past a missing stop end, an open joint cannot say.
findings.note: Genre & source-plausibility: the implied reader is a practising surveyor deciding what to record on an inspection, not the general educated reader the short-ELF exemplars address. host-ver2-2019-verb1-ELF-031 opens 'Education is key to increased economic equality' and var-2022-1-verb1-ELF-031 opens 'Aging research may be on the rise, but it does have its own set of unique limitations' - both orient a lay reader in sentence one and use no unglossed trade vocabulary. This text opens cold inside the trade ('Above a window head') and stacks window head / cavity / tray / stop end / outer skin unglossed. Sits at the edge of the exemplar genre range rather than outside it; adjudication decides.

class 6: idiomatic/semantic temperature miss. The passage's own glossary defines stomme as 'stången med sina tvärslåar och järnringar, alltså skelettet', so this reads tautologically as 'skelettet bär bara skelettet'. The intended sense is that the saved frame transmits only the bare form onward; a native copy editor would write e.g. 'Stommen för bara skelettet vidare' or 'Stommen bär bara formen'.

findings.quote: vattnet i klumparna frös, vidgade sig och sprängde sönder dem
findings.note: class 6 (idiomatic temperature): for the volumetric expansion of freezing water Swedish edited prose collocates with 'utvidga sig' ('vatten utvidgas när det fryser'); reflexive 'vidga sig' normally describes an opening/gap/pupil widening. Native alternative: 'vattnet i klumparna frös, utvidgade sig och sprängde sönder dem'. Taste-level only — grammatical and comprehensible.

class 6 (idiomatic temperature): the passage and the glossary both define 'stomme' AS the skeleton ('stomme = ... alltså skelettet som sedan lövas'), so 'Stommen bär bara skelettet' reads as a tautology where the intended sense is that the frame carries only the bare form forward, not the decoration. Native alternative: 'Stommen för bara skelettet vidare' or 'Stommen bestämmer bara skelettet'. Taste-level; the figurative reading is recoverable.

class 6: the passage's own glossary defines stomme as 'alltså skelettet', so the sentence reads tautologically ('the skeleton carries only the skeleton'); the intended sense is that only the bare frame is handed on. A native copy editor would write 'Stommen för bara skelettet vidare.' or 'Stommen bär bara skelettet vidare.'
